speaker: Derrol Nail
role: NASA Launch Commentator, Kennedy Space Center
text: And here we go.

speaker: Derrol Nail
role: NASA Launch Commentator, Kennedy Space Center
text: Ten, nine, eight, seven...

speaker: Derrol Nail
role: NASA Launch Commentator, Kennedy Space Center
text: RS-25 engines lit!

speaker: Derrol Nail
role: NASA Launch Commentator, Kennedy Space Center
text: Four, three, two, one...

speaker: Derrol Nail
role: NASA Launch Commentator, Kennedy Space Center
text: Booster ignition and liftoff!

speaker: Derrol Nail
role: NASA Launch Commentator, Kennedy Space Center
text: The crew of Artemis II, now bound for the Moon!

speaker: Derrol Nail
role: NASA Launch Commentator, Kennedy Space Center
text: Humanity's next great voyage begins.

speaker: Reid Wiseman
role: Artemis II Commander, Orion 'Integrity'
text: Good roll pitch.

speaker: Launch Control
role: Flight Dynamics & Houston CAPCOM
text: Roger, roll pitch.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Houston now controlling the flight of Integrity on the Artemis II mission around the Moon.

speaker: Launch Control
role: Flight Dynamics & Houston CAPCOM
text: Integrity, AMC high.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: On time passing 30 seconds into the flight. Integrity passes the alternate vehicle target milestone.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Mission Control Houston seeing good performance on four main engines.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Space Launch System core stage and Integrity three miles in altitude, traveling more than 1,200 miles per hour.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Mission elapsed time passing one minute, approaching Max-Q on Ponce de Leon.

speaker: Launch Control
role: Flight Dynamics & Houston CAPCOM
text: Integrity, Houston, we have you loud and clear on Ponce de Leon.

speaker: Reid Wiseman
role: Artemis II Commander, Orion 'Integrity'
text: Have you the same!

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Communication signal transfer confirmed as Integrity and its crew go supersonic!

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Approaching 90 seconds into the Artemis II mission — Integrity is 14 miles in altitude, 8 miles downrange, traveling more than 2,600 miles per hour.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: One minute 50 seconds of mission elapsed time. Standing by for main engine throttle down to 85 percent...

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: ...ahead of Solid Rocket Booster separation, expected at the 2-minute 9-second mark.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: We see throttle down.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Confirm separation!

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Main engines throttling up. Guidance converged.

speaker: Launch Control
role: Flight Dynamics & Houston CAPCOM
text: Integrity, Houston — guidance converged, performance nominal, upper stage RCS ready.

speaker: Reid Wiseman
role: Artemis II Commander, Orion 'Integrity'
text: Copy all, Houston.

speaker: Reid Wiseman
role: Artemis II Commander, Orion 'Integrity'
text: Integrity, SM priming complete.

speaker: Launch Control
role: Flight Dynamics & Houston CAPCOM
text: Copy, SM priming complete.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Two minutes 45 seconds of mission elapsed time into the Artemis II mission.

speaker: Gary Jordan
role: NASA Ascent Commentator, Mission Control Houston
text: Thrusters on Integrity and upper stage confirmed in a ready state ahead of service module fairing separation.
